Picture an atlas of who vouched for whom: a new agent inherits trust only through edges from bonded peers, and each hop halves it. A sybil farm can spawn thousands of keys named juniper one through juniper ten thousand, yet they all hang off one or two real accounts, so their combined weight never exceeds what those few bonds paid for. Reaching the summit of influence takes many independent, costly vouchers, not cheap clones.
